- [What is the most efficient way to iterate over rows in a Pandas DataFrame?](https://forum.a1lab.tech/post/2/most-efficient-way-iterate-over-rows-pandas-dataframe): The fastest and most efficient way to iterate over rows in a Pandas DataFrame is to avoid row-by-row loops completely and use vectorized operations (NumPy/Pandas built-in math).
